# The `## <tool>` sections of docs/TESTS.md that no test yet executes line for line
# through onboarding.CompareTranscript, one per line as <tool>, each with the issue
# that owes it (docs/SPEC-TOOLWORK.md §7 rule 3, PR #1637 at 32b73d77).
#
# THE LIST ONLY SHRINKS. TestEveryTranscriptIsExecutedLineForLine checks it in BOTH
# directions: a section that is not listed and that no test executes with the one
# comparator is red, and a listed section that a test now executes with the one
# comparator and no other is a stale entry and red too. So the list cannot be
# widened and left there, and a conversion that forgets to delete its line is red on
# the pull request that makes it.
#
# A listed section is exempt from BOTH halves of the rule while it is listed: it
# still compares the way it compares today -- a `printed map[string]bool` set, an
# onboarding.Shape prefix, an onboarding.Execute call, or nothing at all -- and that
# is what its card converts. Deleting the line and converting the section are one
# change.

nova-review   # #1653 -- executed by no test
